errors.evidence: This is a horizontal bar chart, meaning the categories are on the vertical axis, not the horizontal one.

errors.text_span: – "Да, между 1-3 бр.", "Да, между 4-6 бр." и "Да, между 82,2%"
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly lists the categories. It omits the category "Не" and incorrectly includes the value "82,2%" as a category label.

errors.text_span: Тази ос е подредена в азбучен ред.
errors.evidence: The categories on the vertical axis ("Не", "Да, между 1-3 бр.", "Да, между 4-6 бр.") are not sorted in alphabetical order.
The vertical axis contains the categories, while the horizontal axis represents the percentage values.

errors.text_span: Мащабът на вертикалната ос е линеен, като минималната стойност е 0% а максималната стойност е 82,2%.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly refers to the vertical axis for the scale. Furthermore, the value axis (horizontal) has no visible tick marks, labels, or a defined range, so stating its scale and range is a hallucination.
The lowest bar in the chart has a value of 2.2%, not 15.6%.

errors.text_span: Има една стълба, която представлява общините, използващи самостоятелни мобилни приложения, където тя е обозначена със зелен цвят.
errors.evidence: This statement is misleading. There are two bars representing municipalities with apps ("Да, между 1-3 бр." and "Да, между 4-6 бр."), not just one. Also, all three bars are green, so singling one out as green is confusing.
